body:
Sesh's Mango Sesh+ Pouches suits adults who want nicotine in a small, mess-free format. Place a pouch between your lip and gum, and it releases flavor and nicotine as directed on the label.

Mango Sesh+ Pouches is listed at $5.99 - $24.99 in our Nicotine Pouches range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Nicotine Pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Sweet Fruit points to layered tropical notes that taste rounded and full. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Sesh
- **Category:** Nicotine Pouches
- **Flavor:** Sweet Fruit
- **Nicotine strength:** 4mg, 6mg, 8mg
- **Capacity:** 15-20 Pouches/Can
- **Packaging:** Single, 5 Pack
- **Price:** $5.99 - $24.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Discreet format:** no smoke or vapor, which can be convenient where vaping is not appropriate.
- **Tobacco-free pouch:** contains no tobacco leaf, so there is nothing to spit or dispose of beyond the used pouch.
- **Sealed can:** keeps the pouches fresh and the flavor consistent until you open it.

### Strength and size options
This listing offers more than one option — strengths 4mg, 6mg, 8mg and pack sizes Single, 5 Pack. Choose yours above the Add to Cart button and the price updates to match, then set the quantity you need. Your choice appears in your cart and on your order confirmation, so there is no guessing at fulfillment.

## Who it suits
Mango Sesh+ Pouches suits adult nicotine users who want a discreet, device-free option and who are comfortable with a pouch format.

## Using and caring for it
Use only as directed on the can. Start with the lowest strength if you are new to nicotine pouches, keep a pouch in place for the time recommended on the label, and dispose of used pouches in a bin rather than on the ground. Store cans in a cool, dry place, close the lid after each use, and keep them away from children and pets. Nicotine is addictive.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
